result.brief: 提出 SNAP，通过姿态条件局部解码器与潜空间重建目标，抑制解码器表达力以保留可迁移的多视角几何表征，在定位、位姿、对应、深度与机器人操作任务上验证。
result.reason: Self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer with latent-space reconstruction objective learns transferable multi-view geometric representations; directly a visual representation learning contribution, not merely using an encoder as baseline.
